description: This file is a shell script used for testing rename detection in Git. It defines test scenarios, prepares reference and working trees, runs diff commands, and validates the output to verify Git's rename and copy detection behavior.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: A macro to define a test case expecting success, executing the provided commands.

methods.name: git update-index
methods.description: A Git command to add or remove files from the index.

methods.name: git write-tree
methods.description: Creates a tree object from the current index.

methods.name: git diff-index
methods.description: Shows diff of files between the index and a given tree.

methods.name: compare_diff_patch
methods.description: A custom function to compare the generated diff output against expected output.
